# Swift Agents

> Swift Agents is an AI-powered customer engagement platform by Serendpt AI. Businesses deploy AI support agents that automate repetitive customer conversations across live chat, voice, and embeddable widgets — resolving support tickets without scaling human headcount.

Swift Agents targets support teams drowning in repetitive queries: the platform automates the bulk of conversations and hands the rest to humans, so teams stop hiring linearly as conversation volume grows.

## Pages

- [Home](https://swiftagents.org/en): Platform overview — what Swift Agents does and who it is for
- [Agents](https://swiftagents.org/en/agents): The AI agents available and what each one handles
- [Products](https://swiftagents.org/en/products): Product lineup, including live chat, voice AI, and the embeddable widget
- [Demo](https://swiftagents.org/en/demo): Interactive ROI calculator — enter conversation volume, team size, and cost per agent to see the support headcount and spend Swift Agents removes
- [Scale Support](https://swiftagents.org/en/landing): How teams scale customer support without scaling headcount
- [Sign Up](https://swiftagents.org/en/signup): Create a Swift Agents account
